publisher: Parker English 怕渴英文（TOEIC 聽力模擬試題）
label: 聽力 4

ex.en: 1. Whose turn is it to take the minutes?

tips.t: take the minutes 做會議記錄（別聽成「分鐘」，Part 2 經典陷阱）。

ex.en: 2. How can we meet the project deadline?
ex.zh: 2. 我們要怎麼趕上專案的截止期限？

tips.t: meet the deadline 趕上期限；extend the deadline 延期。

ex.en: (A) We've got to have the staff work overtime.

tips.t: work overtime 加班；overtime pay 加班費。

ex.en: 4. Lily just contacted a real estate agent about our new retail space.
ex.zh: 4. Lily 剛聯絡了房仲，詢問我們新店面的事。

tips.t: retail price 零售價；retail store 零售店。

ex.en: (C) Yes, Michelle and I will proofread it again later.
ex.zh: (C) 是的，Michelle 和我晚點會再校對一次。

tips.t: proofread a report 校對報告；三態 proofread-proofread-proofread。

ex.en: 8. Could you share your findings at the sales training meeting on Friday?
ex.zh: 8. 你可以在週五的業務訓練會議上分享你的研究結果嗎？

tips.t: present the findings 報告研究結果。

ex.en: 13. How much sales growth do they project?
ex.zh: 13. 他們預估銷售成長多少？

tips.t: projected sales 預估銷售額（動詞重音在後）。

ex.en: 17. What should we do about the defective films we received?
ex.zh: 17. 我們收到的瑕疵底片該怎麼處理？

tips.t: return a defective item 退回瑕疵品。
send a reminder 寄提醒通知。

ex.en: 20. How much did you spend purchasing office supplies last quarter?
ex.zh: 20. 你上一季買辦公用品花了多少錢？

tips.t: first-quarter sales 第一季銷售；quarterly report 季報。

lq.q: Whose turn is it to take the minutes?
lq.zq: 輪到誰做會議記錄？
opts: It will take about fifteen minutes.
I'll do it.
Marcus did it.

lq.q: How can we meet the project deadline?
lq.zq: 我們要怎麼趕上專案的截止期限？
opts: We've got to have the staff work overtime.
Are we leaving the projector on?
The meeting went too long.

lq.q: Has the virus been removed from my laptop?
lq.zq: 我筆電裡的病毒清掉了嗎？
opts: Yes, but some data are also lost.
Yes, it's been moved to the corner.
Not yet, the city hall hasn't approved it.
zo: 清掉了，但也有些資料不見了。

lq.q: Lily just contacted a real estate agent about our new retail space.
lq.zq: Lily 剛聯絡了房仲，詢問我們新店面的事。
opts: She is always so efficient in her work.
No, they were contact lenses.
What do you think of the retail prices?

lq.q: Don't you think the last passage can be further improved?
lq.zq: 你不覺得最後一段還可以再改進嗎？
opts: No, the passengers didn't complain.
Sure, the cover can be removed.
Yes, Michelle and I will proofread it again later.
zo: 是的，Michelle 和我晚點會再校對一次。

lq.q: Where can we display these new product samples?
lq.zq: 這些新產品樣品可以放在哪裡展示？
opts: In the glass case by the register.
They're still working on a screenplay.
From a new supplier.

lq.q: You have no more appointments scheduled for this afternoon, do you?
lq.zq: 你今天下午沒有其他約了，對吧？
opts: No, I'm free after 2:30.
Yes, it's quite disappointing.
Yes, it is.
zo: 沒有，我兩點半以後有空。

lq.q: Could you share your findings at the sales training meeting on Friday?
lq.zq: 你可以在週五的業務訓練會議上分享你的研究結果嗎？
opts: Not everyone was present.
A fine for unpaid tax.
That's the purpose of my research.
zo: 這正是我做研究的目的。

lq.q: Why do you show up to work so early in the morning?
lq.zq: 你為什麼一大早就來上班？
opts: To avoid the rush hour traffic.
Due to the shower this morning.
I got caught in the traffic.
zo: 為了避開尖峰時段的車潮。
因為今天早上下了陣雨。

lq.q: Can you help look over these résumés this afternoon?
lq.zq: 你今天下午可以幫忙看這些履歷嗎？
opts: Sure, here's my application.
I prefer a room overlooking the lake.
Sorry, but I'm tied up all day.

lq.q: Where will the president make her annual speech?
lq.zq: 董事長的年度演講會在哪裡舉行？
opts: We were upgraded to a presidential suite.
It was so boring and also tedious.
On the third floor by the lounge.
zo: 我們被升等到總統套房。

lq.q: What kind of cake should we buy for Kimberly's retirement party?
lq.zq: Kimberly 的退休派對我們該買哪種蛋糕？
opts: She doesn't like anything sour.
Every other week.
We had a great time.

lq.q: How much sales growth do they project?
lq.zq: 他們預估銷售成長多少？
opts: 120 each.
They're expecting at least five percent over last year.
About 20 projectors, I think.
zo: 他們預期比去年至少成長百分之五。
我想大約二十台投影機。

lq.q: Will your art museum still be open this evening?
lq.zq: 你們美術館今晚還開放嗎？
opts: Yes, our main gallery will reopen next week.
A free map is available at the counter.
I'm afraid there's a private event at six.
zo: 是的，我們的主展廳下週重新開放。

lq.q: Were you able to get through to her, or should I try calling?
lq.zq: 你聯絡上她了嗎？還是要我打打看？
opts: We didn't pull through the recession.
It always went to voicemail when I called.
Let me put you through to her.
zo: 我打的時候都轉到語音信箱。

lq.q: Our company is going to open a branch in Bangkok next year.
lq.zq: 我們公司明年要在曼谷開分公司。
opts: We'll need to transfer some staff.
What brand do you recommend?
There's an overseas call for you.
zo: 我們得調派一些員工過去。

lq.q: What should we do about the defective films we received?
lq.zq: 我們收到的瑕疵底片該怎麼處理？
opts: Do we still have the receipt?
Offer them a refund.
Send them replacements.

lq.q: Don't forget to get some euros before our trip to Germany.
lq.zq: 去德國之前別忘了換些歐元。
opts: Sure, I prefer a window seat.
I already have a visa.
Thanks for the reminder.

lq.q: Have you received the survey data from the agency, or should I ask them to hurry up?
lq.zq: 你收到調查公司的資料了嗎？還是要我催他們？
opts: Yes, they are very firm in their demands.
Let me check my email.
Yes, based on the data they provided.
zo: 是的，他們的要求很堅定。
是的，根據他們提供的資料。

lq.q: How much did you spend purchasing office supplies last quarter?
lq.zq: 你上一季買辦公用品花了多少錢？
opts: Why don't you ask Mr. Nelson in Accounting?
We ran out of copy paper.
Because we didn't meet the monthly quota.
zo: 你何不問問會計部的 Nelson 先生？
因為我們沒達到每月配額。
